```python
"""URL normalization, text processing, stemming, and stopwords."""

import re
import urllib.parse
from html.parser import HTMLParser

# Common English stopwords
STOPWORDS = set([
    'a', 'an', 'the', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for',
    'of', 'with', 'by', 'from', 'is', 'are', 'was', 'were', 'be', 'been',

    'most', 'other', 'some', 'such', 'no', 'nor', 'not', 'only',
    'own', 'same', 'so', 'than', 'too', 'very', 'just', 'because',
    'as', 'until', 'while', 'if', 'this', 'that', 'these', 'those',
    'it', 'its', 'he', 'she', 'they', 'them', 'their', 'his', 'her',
    'my', 'your', 'our', 'we', 'you', 'i', 'me', 'us', 'who', 'whom',
    'which', 'what', 'whose', 'am', 'is', 'are', 'was', 'were',
    'been', 'being', 'have', 'has', 'had', 'having', 'does', 'did',
    'doing', 'would', 'could', 'should', 'might', 'shall', 'can',
    'will', 'must', 'also', 'into', 'has', 'more', 'new', 'one',
    'two', 'first', 'second', 'get', 'go', 'went', 'come', 'came',
    'know', 'knew', 'take', 'took', 'see', 'saw', 'think', 'thought',
    'say', 'said', 'make', 'made', 'use', 'used', 'find', 'found',
    'give', 'gave', 'tell', 'told', 'work', 'still', 'last', 'long',
    'great', 'little', 'right', 'left', 'high', 'low', 'old',
    'young', 'big', 'small', 'large', 'different', 'between',
    'part', 'place', 'year', 'group', 'world', 'thing', 'life',
    'hand', 'child', 'man', 'woman', 'case', 'point', 'government',
    'company', 'number', 'problem', 'fact', 'lot', 'others'
])

def normalize_url(base_url: str, href: str) -> str | None:
    """Resolve relative URL, strip fragment, return absolute URL or None if invalid."""
    if href is None:
        return None
    href = href.strip()
    if not href:
        return None
    # Skip javascript:, mailto:, tel:, etc.
    if any(href.lower().startswith(p) for p in ('javascript:', 'mailto:', 'tel:', 'data:', '#')):
        return None
    try:
        # Resolve relative URL
        absolute = urllib.parse.urljoin(base_url, href)
        # Parse and strip fragment
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(absolute)
        # Only http and https
        if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https'):
            return None
        # Rebuild without fragment
        clean = urllib.parse.urlunparse((
            parsed.scheme,
            parsed.netloc.lower(),
            parsed.path.rstrip('/') or '/',
            parsed.params,
            parsed.query,
            ''  # no fragment
        ))
        return clean
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None

def get_domain(url: str) -> str:
    """Extract domain from URL."""
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
    return parsed.netloc.lower()

def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Clean and normalize text: lowercase, collapse whitespace."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
    return text.strip()

def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Tokenize text: lowercase, remove punctuation, split, filter stopwords, stem."""
    text = clean_text(text)
    # Remove punctuation and non-alpha characters
    words = re.findall(r'[a-z]+', text)
    # Filter stopwords and short words
    words = [w for w in words if w not in STOPWORDS and len(w) > 1]
    # Stem
    words = [stem(w) for w in words]
    return words

def stem(word: str) -> str:
    """Simple Porter-style stemmer."""
    if len(word) <= 2:
        return word
    
    # Step 1a: plurals
    if word.endswith('sses'):
        word = word[:-2]
    elif word.endswith('ies'):
        word = word[:-2]
    elif word.endswith('ss'):
        pass  # don't change
    elif word.endswith('s'):
        word = word[:-1]
    
    # Step 1b: -ed, -ing
    if word.endswith('eed'):
        if len(word) > 3:
            word = word[:-1]  # eed -> ee
    elif word.endswith('ed'):
        if len(word) > 3:
            word = word[:-2]
            word = _step1b_helper(word)
    elif word.endswith('ing'):
        if len(word) > 4:
            word = word[:-3]
            word = _step1b_helper(word)
    
    # Step 1c: y -> i
    if word.endswith('y') and len(word) > 2 and word[-2] not in 'aeiou':
        word = word[:-1] + 'i'
    
    # Step 2
    word = _step2(word)
    
    # Step 3
    word = _step3(word)
    
    # Step 4
    word = _step4(word)
    
    # Step 5
    if word.endswith('e'):
        if len(word) > 2:
            word = word[:-1]
    if word.endswith('ll') and len(word) > 2:
        word = word[:-1]
    
    return word

def _step1b_helper(word: str) -> str:
    """Helper for step 1b: handle double consonants after removing -ed/-ing."""
    if word.endswith(('at', 'bl', 'iz')):
        word += 'e'
    elif word.endswith(('bb', 'dd', 'ff', 'gg', 'mm', 'nn', 'pp', 'rr', 'tt')):
        word = word[:-1]
    elif len(word) >= 3 and word[-1] == word[-2] and word[-1] not in 'aeiouls':
        word = word[:-1]
    return word

def _step2(word: str) -> str:
    """Step 2 of Porter stemmer."""
    if len(word) < 4:
        return word
    suffixes = [
        ('ational', 'ate'), ('tional', 'tion'), ('enci', 'ence'),
        ('anci', 'ance'), ('izer', 'ize'), ('abli', 'able'),
        ('alli', 'al'), ('entli', 'ent'), ('eli', 'e'),
        ('ousli', 'ous'), ('ization', 'ize'), ('ation', 'ate'),
        ('ator', 'ate'), ('alism', 'al'), ('iveness', 'ive'),
        ('fulness', 'ful'), ('ousness', 'ous'), ('aliti', 'al'),
        ('iviti', 'ive'), ('biliti', 'ble'),
    ]
    for suffix, replacement in suffixes:
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            return word[:-len(suffix)] + replacement
    return word

def _step3(word: str) -> str:
    """Step 3 of Porter stemmer."""
    if len(word) < 4:
        return word
    suffixes = [
        ('icate', 'ic'), ('ative', ''), ('alize', 'al'),
        ('iciti', 'ic'), ('ical', 'ic'), ('ful', ''),
        ('ness', ''),
    ]
    for suffix, replacement in suffixes:
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            return word[:-len(suffix)] + replacement
    return word

def _step4(word: str) -> str:
    """Step 4 of Porter stemmer."""
    if len(word) < 4:
        return word
    suffixes = ['ement', 'ance', 'ence', 'able', 'ible', 'ment',
                'ant', 'ent', 'ism', 'ate', 'iti', 'ous', 'ive', 'ize']
    for suffix in suffixes:
        if word.endswith(suffix) and len(word) > len(suffix) + 2:
            return word[:-len(suffix)]
    # Handle -tion, -sion
    if word.endswith(('tion', 'sion')) and len(word) > 4:
        return word[:-3]
    return word

class TextExtractor(HTMLParser):
    """Extract visible text from HTML, skipping scripts and styles."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.text_parts = []
        self.skip = False
        self.skip_tags = {'script', 'style', 'noscript', 'meta', 'link', 'head'}
    
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag.lower() in self.skip_tags:
            self.skip = True
    
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag.lower() in self.skip_tags:
            self.skip = False
        # Add spacing for block-level elements
        if tag.lower() in {'p', 'br', 'div', 'li', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'h6',
                           'tr', 'td', 'th', 'section', 'article', 'header', 'footer'}:
            self.text_parts.append(' ')
    
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.skip:
            self.text_parts.append(data)

class LinkExtractor(HTMLParser):
    """Extract all href links from anchor tags."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.links = []
        self.in_a = False
    
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag.lower() == 'a':
            self.in_a = True
            attrs_dict = dict(attrs)
            href = attrs_dict.get('href', '')
            if href:
                self.links.append(href)
    
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag.lower() == 'a':
            self.in_a = False
```
